CONCLUSION: m6A methylation status and differential expression status are NOT independent in this bladder cancer dataset; the null hypothesis of independence is overwhelmingly rejected (p ≈ 2.95 × 10⁻⁷² in the primary row-level test).

LIMITATIONS: duplicated transcript rows treated as independent observations per the approved plan; the DEG label is p-value-driven (no-DEGs can show |log2FC| up to ~5–6); the gene-level sensitivity uses a union rule; no multiplicity correction (single pre-specified test).
